name: nexus-harness
description: Local-first development harness: one CLI invocation runs a task through the workspace, check, and bounded repair loop.

scripts.test:policy:config: vitest run --project policy tests/boundaries.test.ts tests/completion-config.test.ts tests/completion-gate.test.ts tests/config.test.ts tests/validation-cache.test.ts
scripts.test:policy:loop: vitest run --project policy tests/completion-policy.test.ts tests/runner-policy.test.ts tests/stop.test.ts tests/support.test.ts
scripts.test:policy:intake: vitest run --project policy tests/baseline-findings.test.ts tests/jira.test.ts tests/queue-recovery.test.ts tests/queue.test.ts
scripts.test:policy:history: vitest run --project policy tests/history-runner.test.ts tests/history-source.test.ts tests/history.test.ts tests/reviews.test.ts
scripts.validate: node scripts/turbo.mjs run format:check lint typecheck build test:policy:display test:policy:config test:policy:loop test:policy:intake test:policy:history test:boundary
scripts.validate:fresh: npm run cache:clear && npm run validate
